front.title: QIK-VRT Lossless Framing and Effect Acknowledgement Boundaries

abstract.t: This document describes an experimental octet-framing protocol for lossless carriage of finite binary payloads and distinguishes frame delivery from verified execution effects. It does not grant access to protected resources or establish physical universality.

section.name: Introduction
section.t: Different physical media can transport digital representations when suitable transducers, channels and permissions exist. This document defines a candidate octet frame and an effect-verification boundary.

section.name: Frame Format
section.t: All widths are octets. The start marker is three ASCII octets 0x30 0x30 0x31, not the three bits 001. The end marker is 0x31 0x30 0x30.
section.artwork: 3 octets: ASCII "001" 8 octets: unsigned big-endian payload length N 32 octets: SHA-256 digest of payload N octets: opaque payload (0 <= N <= 16777216) 3 octets: ASCII "100"
section.t: Payload contents are opaque and may contain the markers. Receivers reject malformed markers, oversized declared lengths, digest mismatch and truncated frames. SHA-256 is not sender authentication.

section.name: Streaming
section.t: Frames may be concatenated and arbitrarily partitioned into transport chunks. Successful decoding establishes only byte recovery. Implementations must bound input chunks and buffering before use with untrusted streams.

section.name: Effect Acknowledgement
section.t: The closing marker is not EFFECT_ACK_DONE. A trusted effect receipt requires authenticated principals, unique operation identifiers, durable idempotency, replay protection, writer fencing, an independently observed effect and a cryptographically bound receipt. The reference implementation does not yet implement these guarantees.

section.name: Security Considerations
section.t: Authenticated transport, authorization, replay defense, quotas and verifier trust are required in production. This protocol cannot bypass encryption, firewalls or VPN access controls.

section.name: IANA Considerations
section.t: This document requests no IANA actions.
